TAP-TARGET:the-tell.html.fix: Measure during play, not at load: either fold the touch probe into playthrough-agent.py (which already drives breadth-first), or give studio-fingers a --drive mode that clicks bounded breadth-first and re-probes after each transition. Revealing hidden .screen elements is NOT sufficient - the controls are JS-built on transition, so they do not exist until the game is actually played.
TAP-TARGET:the-tell.html.root_cause: studio-fingers.py does page.goto() then evaluates PROBE immediately, so it measures the FIRST PAINT ONLY. TSP games use .screen{display:none}/.screen.on, and .tagspot controls are built by renderPiece() when the board opens. The gate's selector is NOT the problem - it already matches [role="button"], which .tagspot sets. The gate simply never navigates past screen one, so EVERY control built after the entry screen in EVERY multi-screen game in the corpus has never been touch-measured.
